abyss-teal.$description: Abyss Teal — Teal text accent for links, tags, and emphasized short phrases. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

mint-beacon.$description: Mint Beacon — Green text accent for links, tags, and emphasized short phrases. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

coral-ember.$description: Coral Ember — Decorative icon accent — used sparingly in nav icons and the hero illustration's mountain highlights. Warm counterpoint to the cool teal/mint palette

lavender-mist.$description: Lavender Mist — Hero atmosphere — the soft lavender backdrop of the hero section and mountain illustration sky. Only used in the hero band; never in component surfaces or UI chrome

void.$description: Void — Page canvas and primary action background — the base layer of the dark theme and the fill of filled CTA buttons (Enter Studio, Discord). Slightly green-tinted black rather than pure neutral

carbon.$description: Carbon — Deep surface — code block backgrounds, terminal interiors, darkest elevated layers. One step below void for maximum contrast terminal aesthetic

slate.$description: Slate — Mid surface and hairline borders — card backgrounds, button borders, dividers. Bridges between void and the lighter elevated steps

graphite.$description: Graphite — Elevated card surface and hover-state fills — the topmost card tier, used for testimonial cards and hover backgrounds

fog.$description: Fog — Muted text and inactive nav icons — body helper text, inactive nav glyphs, secondary metadata. The de-emphasized reading layer

ash.$description: Ash — Hairline borders and dividers — the universal 1px border color used across nav, cards, icons, and structural separators. Primary border token

paper.$description: Paper — Primary text and icon fill — all high-emphasis body copy, headings, and filled icon shapes. The top of the text contrast scale

poppins.$description: All UI and display copy. Weight 300 dominates display and hero headings, creating an unusually quiet headline voice — the database speaks softly. Weight 400 for body and nav, 500 for button labels and emphasized metadata, 700 reserved for rare structural emphasis.

monospace.$description: Code snippets, terminal output, SQL examples, and inline technical tokens. System monospace at a single small size — functional, not decorative.
